identity.name: Mark Colenburg
identity.summary: St. Louis church drummer who came up with Common and Q-Tip and joined the Robert Glasper Experiment in 2011.

contribution.description: A church-trained drummer at the centre of the 2010s jazz and hip-hop crossover: the Robert Glasper Experiment from 2011, a Grammy for "Jesus Children", and the drums on A Tribe Called Quest's last album.
